WITH equip_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    e.EQUIP_CODE,
    e.EquipType,
    e.model_name,
    e.MakerName,
    e.SERVICE_YRS,
    e.utilPercent,
    e.RELIAB_IDX,
    om.OPER_hours,
    om.maintCycleHrs,
    om.OPER_status,
    et.type_indices->>'performance_score'::real AS perf_score,
    et.type_indices->>'environmental_impact_idx'::real AS env_impact
  FROM "Equipment" e
  JOIN "OperationMaintenance" om ON om."equipRef" = e.EQUIP_CODE
  JOIN "EquipmentType" et ON et."EquipType" = e.EquipType
),
with_scores AS (
  SELECT 
    *,
    -- EER
    ((perf_score + RELIAB_IDX) / 2.0) * (1.0 - env_impact / 100.0) AS EER,
    -- ORS
    CASE 
      WHEN OPER_status = 'Active' THEN 10.0 * (1.0 - OPER_hours / maintCycleHrs)
      WHEN OPER_status = 'Standby' THEN 5.0 * (1.0 - OPER_hours / maintCycleHrs)
      ELSE 0
    END AS ORS
  FROM equip_metrics
),
with_loss AS (
  SELECT 
    *,
    ROUND(CAST(0.5 * EER + 0.5 * ORS * (1.0 - OPER_hours / 20000.0) AS numeric), 2) AS LOSS
  FROM with_scores
)
SELECT 
  EQUIP_CODE, EquipType, model_name, MakerName, SERVICE_YRS, utilPercent, RELIAB_IDX,
  OPER_hours, maintCycleHrs, OPER_status,
  ROUND(CAST(EER AS numeric), 2) AS EER,
  ROUND(CAST(ORS AS numeric), 2) AS ORS,
  LOSS
FROM with_loss
ORDER BY EquipType, LOSS DESC
LIMIT 20;
